items.title: Microsoft Edge: Simplified Energy Saver
items.description: Energy saver, formerly known as efficiency mode, will have new defaults and different setting options. Edge will now support and recommend users to use the BatterySaverModeAvailability policy to manage the energy saver feature. The energy saver feature has been simplified to become enabled under two conditions: on low battery or when unplugged. The default will be for energy saver to be enabled on low battery. Energy saver will now have one mode. Users set to Balanced savings will be mapped to h

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Apply default SharePoint library labels to data at rest
items.description: Enables auto‑labeling of existing SharePoint files to match the default sensitivity label configured on their document library. This helps organizations close labeling gaps for data at rest and ensure consistent, secure‑by‑default protection across SharePoint libraries—without relying on manual user labeling.

items.title: Planner: Expiration of plans from meetings due to inactivity
items.description: Planner plans created from Teams meetings (via Meeting Notes or Loop) often remain unused long after the meeting ends. These inactive plans accumulate and clutter over time. This feature automatically expires and deletes meeting-created plans that have had no task activity for 180 days. Only the Planner plan is removed whereas the tasks in Loop and meeting notes stay intact.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Report suspicious guest invitations
items.description: Microsoft Teams will enable users to report suspicious guest invitations directly from Teams. When users receive an unexpected or potentially malicious guest invitation, they can report it to their IT admin for review, helping identify and mitigate phishing and other abuse through guest invitations.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enable agents for existing applications in your organization
items.description: For third-party applications already being used in your organization, admins can now discover and enable the corresponding Teams agents from within the Teams Admin Center. Admins receive recommendations for high-value agents and gain visibility into any required configuration changes during the enablement workflow. These agents increase employee productivity by bringing their everyday applications into the flow of work in Teams. This helps organizations get more value from their existing softwar

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Self-serve sync connectors
items.description: Self-serve sync connectors enable users to securely connect their own external data sources, such as Jira and Confluence Cloud, to Microsoft 365 Copilot. Using their own credentials and permissions, users can synchronize content they already have access to, making it discoverable in Copilot Chat and Microsoft Search. Administrators maintain oversight through tenant-level controls, including staged rollout, visibility management, and connector disablement.

items.title: SharePoint: Cross-post SharePoint News to Engage
items.description: This feature allows SharePoint News authors to distribute posts to an Engage community or storyline while preserving full fidelity rendering and a unified conversation experience. SharePoint News post will appear consistently in Engage across feeds, digests, Outlook, Teams, desktop, web and mobile apps. When distributed, the SharePoint News comments module is replaced with the richer Engage conversation module, ensuring a single, shared discussion thread across surfaces.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Recently used emojis sync across devices
items.description: Recently used emojis and reactions sync across Teams on desktop and mobile, making it easier to express yourself wherever you work.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Improved content freshness using Copilot connectors with webhooks-led notifications
items.description: Copilot connectors will offer improved content freshness with more frequent sync of updates using webhook event notifications. The following connectors are in scope - Azure DevOps, Jira cloud, Confluence cloud, Trello, Asana, Bitbucket, GitHub and Gitlab.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Improved content freshness using Copilot connectors with webhooks-led notifications
items.description: Copilot connectors will offer improved content freshness with more frequent sync of updates using webhook event notifications. The following connectors are in scope - Azure DevOps, Jira cloud, Confluence cloud, Trello, Asana, Bitbucket, GitHub and Gitlab.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Run Python code as a step in workflows
items.description:
The new Code node lets makers run Python as a step in a workflow for logic that expressions and connectors can't handle.

Data transforms, calculations, regex, and advanced parsing.
File conversion and parsing (for example PDF → text, CSV, XML).
Generate the code from natural language with AI, or write and edit it by hand.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Generate documents from the Agent node in workflows
items.description:
The Agent node can now return files that the agent generates, such as PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and CSV, as workflow outputs.

Works with both inline agents and existing (published) agents.
Generated files appear as an ordered files output (name, content type, content) that's available to downstream steps.
Pass files to connectors to email, save to SharePoint/OneDrive, or attach to records.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Share workflows with co-owners for collaborative editing
items.description:
Makers can share a workflow with other users as co-owners so they can view, edit, and manage it.

Share from the workflows page or the designer.
Review the connections the workflow uses and their permissions before sharing.
See who the workflow is shared with when reopening Share.
Co-owners can edit and run the workflow.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Service principal owner for workflows
items.description: Workflows can now be owned under a service principal (a Microsoft Entra app registration) instead of a named user account.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Voice phishing detection for external calls
items.description: Voice phishing detection helps protect Microsoft Teams users from potential scams during one-to-one calls with people outside their organization. Using AI, Teams analyzes conversations for signs of social engineering and alerts recipients when suspicious activity is detected, helping them recognize potential threats and decide how to proceed.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: EDU tenant type selection in policy wizard
items.description: Admins can now select tenant type for their institution from the policy wizard. This setting can be changed anytime from the wizard.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Latest meeting experiences with performance improvements on web for Safari and Firefox (for anonymous join only)
items.description: The latest Teams meeting experiences will be available for Teams on the web in Safari and Firefox browsers - including performance improvements, refreshed pre-join, updated meeting stage, and the updated meeting toolbar. (for anonymous join only)

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Change background while recording on phone
items.description: You can record a video clip with your phone camera and switch your background to any picture you want or make it blurry. With this feature, you can record yourself anywhere and share it with coworkers in your Teams chat or channel.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: School Connection –  Providing access to parents via their phone number
items.description: The School Connection app in Microsoft Teams (mobile) empowers parents and guardians to engage, support, and monitor their student's learning at school. This release enables a parent/guardian to get access to their child’s profile in School Connection if they login to Teams (mobile) with their phone number and the school has registered that phone number as a parent/guardian contact. Additionally, a parent/guardian will easily get access to their child’s profile if the phone number or email addre

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Microsoft 365 admin centers –  Manage Teams apps that work on Outlook and Microsoft 365 App
items.description: Administrators using the Microsoft 365 admin center and Teams admin center who manage Teams apps that work on Outlook and the Microsoft 365 App will be able to apply their changes across all three clients (Teams, Outlook and Microsoft 365 App). Before this update, changes made through the Integrated Apps section in the Microsoft 365 admin center would only affect these apps on Outlook and the Microsoft 365 App; similarly, changes made in the Teams admin center would exclusively affect Teams. Wit

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Engage - Topic Subscription notification
items.description: This feature allows users to subscribe to notifications for Viva Engage topics they follow. Users will receive a Viva Engage bell notification when a new post is tagged with a topic they are subscribed to or when the topic is added to an existing post.

items.title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: False positive email release from Quarantine through threat explorer, email summary panel, advanced hunting, and custom detection email entity page take action
items.description: SecOps can now mange False positives and take move to inbox (i.e. release) quarantined messages from Threat explorer, advanced hunting, custom detection and Email entity page without the need to tab out to the Quarantine portal to take the action.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Workspaces updates
items.description: With new Copilot Workspaces updates, Work IQ can suggest relevant workspaces based on current workstreams to help people get started quickly. Once in a workspace, team members can work together on shared documents while Copilot connects the dots across the work, surfacing what changed, what remains unresolved, and which actions need attention so everyone can quickly catch up and keep the work moving.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator follow-up mode
items.description: Chat naturally with Facilitator without tagging it each time.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Workflow to automatically add tag members to relevant channels
items.description: Associate channels with a tag so members are automatically added to those channels when they join the tag. This helps teams keep channel membership in sync with evolving groups, reduces manual management, and ensures members have access to the conversations and content most relevant to their role.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced Copilot and AI controls for meetings
items.description: Teams Meetings offer enhanced AI controls for Copilot and AI experiences. Organizers manage who can enable and access AI, while IT admins get a simpler policy model for governing AI across meetings and post-meeting experiences. These updates provide more predictable administration and greater flexibility for compliance and governance scenarios.

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Provide a Copilot starter prompt in Teams and LMS Assignments
items.description: Educators can provide a Copilot starter prompt from Student AI Guidelines in Teams and LMS Assignments. Students open Copilot with the educator's prompt ready in their chat, helping them begin with instructions tailored to the assignment.

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Assign Study and Learn in Teams and LMS Assignments
items.description: Educators can assign Study and Learn from Student AI Guidelines in Teams and LMS Assignments. Students open guided learning support grounded in the assignment's title, instructions, and supported files and resources, helping them work through concepts and practice their understanding.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Introducing IRM Alert classification
items.description: Insider risk management will be introducing the ability to classify alerts as True positive, Benign (operational), and False positive. This will be available on all alerts where authorized analysts with the appropriate permissions can choose from a list of predefined classification reasons. Alert classification will help tenants to better classify risk within alerts to support reporting and tuning needs. This will replace existing dismissal reasons.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: AI Interpreter for Teams Events
items.description: AI Interpreter for Events brings real-time, AI-powered audio interpretation to Teams Town Halls and Webinars, helping global audiences follow events in their preferred language. Organizers can configure supported languages for their event, giving attendees a more natural and engaging multilingual experience beyond translated captions.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Seller experiences - Copy opportunities for repeat deals
items.description:
Administrators can control whether the Copy Opportunity feature is available. When enabled, sellers can duplicate an existing opportunity to quickly create a new one.
The new opportunity retains key customer, deal, product, stakeholder, and custom-field information from the source opportunity, including hidden custom fields. Product line items are copied with their quantities and pricing; inactive products are excluded and recorded in the audit summary.
To ensure the copied opportunity starts as

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Seller experiences - Streamline Quick Campaigns for confident, one-time bulk email outreach
items.description:
Quick Campaigns support multiple bulk activity types (email, tasks, appointments, phone calls). This release focuses on improving the end-to-end experience for bulk email creation, with foundational improvements that benefit the overall Quick Campaigns flow.
Key capabilities include:

Streamlined quick campaign flow: The existing multistep wizard is simplified for Quick Campaigns creation, including one-time bulk email sends. Sellers can create, review, and send bulk emails with fewer steps and

items.title: Microsoft Teams: External presenter support for event group chat
items.description: Event group chat, the private chat for organizers, co-organizers, and presenters in an event or structured meeting, will support external presenters.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Onboarding workflow for new team members
items.description: Help people get started faster by automatically connecting new team members to relevant channels when they join a team. Improve engagement, accelerate onboarding, and make it easier to discover important information from day one.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Third-party synthetic audio and video detection in Microsoft Teams
items.description: Organizations can enhance meeting security with synthetic audio and video detection solutions provided by certified third-party providers. Third-party detection solutions analyze meeting media for signs of synthetic or manipulated audio and video and send detection signals to Teams, enabling integrated in-meeting experiences and controls.  Important: Synthetic media detection is performed by the third-party provider. Microsoft Teams provides the platform integration and experiences for surfacing

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Pop out sign language interpreter meeting video for continuous visibility
items.description: Keep communication more accessible throughout your meeting. You can now pop out a sign language interpreter into a separate, resizable window that stays visible across monitors and apps. Designed to support Deaf and Hard of Hearing users, the sign language interpreter's popout video will persist while viewers are multitasking, sharing content, or changing meeting layouts.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Campaigns Hub in Engage and Engage in Teams mobile
items.description: The Campaigns Hub in Viva Engage provides a centralized mobile destination where employees can discover and participate in organizational campaigns. Available in the Viva Engage app and Viva Engage in Teams mobile, the hub highlights top and sponsored campaigns, enables users to browse active and completed campaigns, and makes it easy to view campaign details and follow the campaigns that matter to them.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Campaigns in SharePoint
items.description: Campaigns in SharePoint (site campaigns) is a new capability that brings Viva Amplify’ s campaign management natively into SharePoint. Corporate communications teams now have a unified place to create, distribute, and measure their news without leaving the platform where their news content already lives. This feature applies only to Amplify users as of now. This is a complementary way to create lighter weight campaigns inside a SharePoint site as a way to organize your SharePoint news posts and

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Data Security for non-Microsoft connected apps
items.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention and Information Protection Auto-labeling capabilities now extend to non-Microsoft connected apps (e.g., Google Workspace, Box, Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Amazon Web Services, and Cisco Webex). The conditions and actions supported for each of these applications vary.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Emoji shortcuts with autocomplete on mobile
items.description: Teams brings desktop-style emoji shortcuts to mobile (iOS and Android), allowing you to insert emojis by typing colon-based commands like :smile:. Real-time autocomplete suggestions help you quickly find the right emoji as you type, while support for custom emojis enables more personalized and expressive communication on the go.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Create full-workload backup policies for Microsoft 365 Backup
items.description: Automatically backup all Exchange or OneDrive users and/or SharePoint sites in the tenant and have the tool automatically add new users/sites to the backup policy.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Writing Assistance with Copilot in Edge is being upgraded to include enterprise data protection compliance standards
items.description: Writing Assistance with Copilot in Edge, which lets users edit typed text for tone, format, and length within an open page in Microsoft Edge, is being updated to include enterprise data protection for commercial customers. Once Writing Assistance is available, users signed in with a Microsoft Entra ID will have enterprise data protection when using the feature in Microsoft Edge.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Search in Viva Connections on iOS and Android tablet
items.description: This adds a search entry point and a new tailored experience for Viva Connection users on iOS and Android tablets.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Sensitivity label inheritance for Teams meeting artifacts
items.description: Teams meeting artifacts, including recordings, transcripts, and Loop notes, can now be configured to automatically inherit the sensitivity label from the meeting. This ensures content generated during meetings is consistently protected without requiring manual labeling, reducing risk and simplifying protection at scale.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Focus on the conversation while Facilitator in Teams mobile takes the notes, now with speaker attribution
items.description: Use Facilitator in Teams mobile to turn in-person conversations into useful notes and follow-ups with speaker attribution. Start note-taking from your phone and let Facilitator capture and transcribe the ad hoc discussion, with speaker attribution helping distinguish who said what. Facilitator uses the conversation to generate notes, summaries, and follow-up actions, giving you a richer record of the discussion while letting you stay more present in the moment.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Bullseye routing with dynamic user groups and skill relaxation
items.description: Bullseye routing now supports dynamic user groups and skill relaxation. Administrators can define dynamic groups using representatives’ skills and proficiency levels, and use them at different expansion levels. If work remains unassigned, required skills can be progressively relaxed to broaden the eligible representative pool and improve assignment opportunities—without manually maintaining group membership.

items.title: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence: D365 Contact Center Admin Center users can create CCI agents
items.description: Use the customer conversation harness agent builder to create, test, and refine AI-powered customer service agents. Accelerate agent development with built-in tools for conversation design, orchestration, evaluation, and deployment across customer engagement channels.

items.title: Planner: Sprints and backlogs in unified plans
items.description: Sprints and backlogs in unified plans let users organize and prioritize work in a product backlog, plan time-boxed sprints, and focus on the current sprint. Sprint planning stays separate from buckets, so teams can continue using buckets to organize work.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Track price changes in Unified pricing management
items.description:
Multiple factors (including seasonal adjustments, promotions, and market dynamics) can influence a product's active sales price, causing it to fluctuate over time. Businesses need a reliable way to detect and act on these changes. For example:

Retail stores must update shelf labels promptly to reflect the latest prices.
E-commerce websites must alert shoppers about price drops for items in their shopping carts, driving conversion.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Enable price change tracking in Unified pricing management
items.description:
Multiple factors, such as seasonal adjustments, promotions, and market dynamics, influence a product’s active sales price and cause it to fluctuate over time. Businesses need a reliable way to detect and act on these changes:

Retail stores must update shelf labels promptly to reflect the latest prices.
E-commerce websites must notify shoppers about price drops for items in their shopping carts to help drive conversion.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Unified Pricing Management - Manage purchase prices and discounts with attribute-based pricing
items.description:
Procurement teams can manage supplier pricing with the same flexible, attribute-based model already used for sales, instead of maintaining large numbers of separate trade agreement lines.
With this feature, Unified Pricing Management attributes extend to vendors and purchase orders. Pricing managers can create purchase pricing contracts that set trade agreement prices and discounts based on attributes. Purchase orders then pick up the correct price and discount automatically.
